Commentary.Commentary: BAD NEWS! It has been raining throughout the day and the umpires, after an inspection of the pitch and the outfield, have decided to call off the game. So, Afghanistan win the series 2-0 and they remain unbeaten in T20Is in 2018. They completely outplayed Ireland who just could not cope up with their spinners. However, the home team will look to turn things around in the ODIs, a format in which, we feel, they will have a better chance. Will Afghanistan continue their domination or will the hosts bounce back? Do join us for the ODIs which will get underway from the 27th of August at 1045 AM local (0945 AM GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye.
